001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * History log record Extended Bolus Activated, opCode 59, size 26.
009 *
010 * <br>
011 *
012 * 
013 * <table border='1'>
014 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
015 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>59</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
016 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Extended Bolus Activated"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
017 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>internalName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"LID_BOLEX_ACTIVATED"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
018 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>usedByTidepool</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>true</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
019 * </table>
020 */
021@HistoryLogProps(
022    opCode = 59,
023    displayName = "Extended Bolus Activated",
024    internalName = "LID_BOLEX_ACTIVATED",
025    usedByTidepool = true
026)
027public class BolexActivatedHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
028
029    private int bolusId;
030    private int selectedIob;
031    private float iob;
032    private float bolexSize;
033
034    public BolexActivatedHistoryLog() {}
035
036    public BolexActivatedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int selectedIob, float iob, float bolexSize) {
037        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, selectedIob, iob, bolexSize, 0);
038    }
039
040    public BolexActivatedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int selectedIob, float iob, float bolexSize, int headerHighNibble) {
041        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
042        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, selectedIob, iob, bolexSize, headerHighNibble);
043        this.bolusId = bolusId;
044        this.selectedIob = selectedIob;
045        this.iob = iob;
046        this.bolexSize = bolexSize;
047    }
048
049    /**
050     * @deprecated byte 12 carries selectedIob, as in {@link BolusActivatedHistoryLog}. This
051     * constructor assumes a selectedIob of 0.
052     */
053    @Deprecated
054    public BolexActivatedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, float iob, float bolexSize) {
055        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, 0, iob, bolexSize);
056    }
057
058    /**
059     * @deprecated see {@link #BolexActivatedHistoryLog(long, long, int, float, float)}
060     */
061    @Deprecated
062    public BolexActivatedHistoryLog(int bolusId, float iob, float bolexSize) {
063        this(0, 0, bolusId, 0, iob, bolexSize);
064    }
065
066    public int typeId() {
067        return 59;
068    }
069
070    /**
071     * <table border="1">
072     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolexActivatedHistoryLog:</caption>
073     * <tr><td><code>bolusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
074     * <tr><td><code>selectedIob</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
075     * <tr><td><code>iob</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
076     * <tr><td><code>bolexSize</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
077     * </table>
078     */
079    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
080        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
081        this.cargo = raw;
082        parseBase(raw);
083        this.bolusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
084        this.selectedIob = raw[12];
085        this.iob = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14);
086        this.bolexSize = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18);
087
088    }
089
090    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int selectedIob, float iob, float bolexSize) {
091        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, selectedIob, iob, bolexSize, 0);
092    }
093
094    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int selectedIob, float iob, float bolexSize, int headerHighNibble) {
095        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
096            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(59, headerHighNibble),
097            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
098            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
099            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId),
100            // bytes 12-13: selectedIob followed by one unused byte (0 in every known record)
101            new byte[]{ (byte) selectedIob, 0 },
102            Bytes.toFloat(iob),
103            Bytes.toFloat(bolexSize)));
104    }
105
106    /**
107     * @deprecated use {@link #buildCargo(long, long, int, int, float, float)}; this overload
108     * writes a selectedIob of 0.
109     */
110    @Deprecated
111    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, float iob, float bolexSize) {
112        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, 0, iob, bolexSize);
113    }
114
115    public int getBolusId() {
116        return bolusId;
117    }
118
119    /**
120     * @return the raw value of byte 12, the IOB algorithm in use; see {@link #getSelectedIobType()}.
121     *
122     * <p>Tandem's cloud schema gives opcode 59 the same fields as opcode 55
123     * ({@link BolusActivatedHistoryLog}), which under the byte-reversed-word cloud mapping puts
124     * selectedIob at BLE byte 12. On the wire, byte 12 equalled
125     * {@link BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog#getSelectedIOB()} of the same bolus in 9/9 opcode 59
126     * records from two Mobi pumps (both 0 and 1 seen), and byte 13 was always 0.
127     * See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/46.
128     */
129    public int getSelectedIob() {
130        return selectedIob;
131    }
132
133    public BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog.SelectedIOBType getSelectedIobType() {
134        return BolusRequestedMsg2HistoryLog.SelectedIOBType.fromId(selectedIob);
135    }
136
137    public float getIob() {
138        return iob;
139    }
140
141    public float getBolexSize() {
142        return bolexSize;
143    }
144
145}
